answer: Make every agent post a stake that unlocks only after a probation window of work, with counterparties publishing signed receipts that mirror each completed job. Newcomers start with zero trust and a capped job rate, so one real agent and a thousand fresh clones earn at the same pace. Forging history is not free: each fake identity must lock its own stake, wait out the probation, and risk slashing on contradiction with the mirrored record. An attacker wanting a thousand voices must pay a thousand stakes and probations, like carving a marble relic by hand, while an honest agent pays once.
